intro: Minneapolis rewards visitors with a mix of outdoor beauty, vibrant culture, and friendly neighborhoods. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
tour_note: Check the tour page for which entry tickets are included.

notes: METRO Blue Line light rail connects the airport, downtown, and Mall of America; fare $2 includes 2.5-hour transfer.
METRO Green Line links downtown Minneapolis to downtown St. Paul via the University of Minnesota.
Buses cover the city; use the Metro Transit app or website for routes and schedules.
Day passes cost $6; 7-day passes $24 (requires Go-To card).
Taxis and ride apps like Uber and Lyft operate; taxis can be hailed or found at ranks.
Driving is common; rush hours (7-9 AM, 3-7 PM) are congested. Walking and biking are pleasant in many areas.

sculpture_garden.name: Minneapolis Sculpture Garden
sculpture_garden.hours: Park open daily roughly 06:00–24:00 · check on the day
sculpture_garden.tip: The giant Spoonbridge and Cherry is the photo everyone wants. Go early to avoid crowds.

stone_arch.name: Stone Arch Bridge
stone_arch.tip: Walk across at sunset for the skyline and the river. Wear shoes with grip; the deck is uneven.

nickelodeon_universe.name: Nickelodeon Universe
nickelodeon_universe.price_text: All-day ride wristband; price varies by date — check on the day
nickelodeon_universe.hours: Varies by day; usually opens late morning · check on the day
nickelodeon_universe.tip: It is indoors inside the Mall of America, so it works on a rainy or cold day. Buy tickets online first.

valleyfair.name: Valleyfair
valleyfair.price_text: Day ticket varies by date — check on the day
valleyfair.hours: Seasonal, roughly May–October · check on the day
valleyfair.tip: It is about 30–40 minutes southwest of downtown by car. Plan a full day and arrive at opening.

university_minnesota.name: University of Minnesota Twin Cities
university_minnesota.hours: Campus grounds open daily · buildings have set hours
university_minnesota.tip: Walk the East Bank and cross the Washington Avenue Bridge for river views. The Weisman Art Museum is free and worth a look.

como_town.name: Como Town
como_town.price_text: Ride wristbands and single tickets; price varies — check on the day
como_town.hours: Seasonal, roughly May–September · check on the day
como_town.tip: It sits next to Como Park Zoo and Conservatory, which are free. Combine both in one trip.

dairy_queen.name: Dairy Queen
dairy_queen.hours: Varies by branch · check on the day
dairy_queen.tip: This is a chain with many branches, not one landmark spot. Use it for a cheap Blizzard break.

dogs_playing_poker.name: Dogs Playing Poker
dogs_playing_poker.price_text: Check locally — location and access not confirmed
dogs_playing_poker.tip: I cannot confirm a public Minneapolis location for this. Confirm the address before you go.

haagen_dazs.name: Häagen-Dazs
haagen_dazs.hours: Varies by branch · check on the day
haagen_dazs.tip: A chain shop, not a sight. Treat it as a quick stop, not a destination.

minnesota_river.name: Minnesota River
minnesota_river.tip: The river runs well southwest of downtown. Pick a riverside park and check access before you drive out.

orange_julius.name: Orange Julius
orange_julius.hours: Varies by branch · check on the day
orange_julius.tip: Often found inside malls such as Mall of America. Good quick drink stop, not a landmark.

mill_city_market.name: Mill City Museum and Mill City Farmers Market
mill_city_market.price_text: Museum admission varies — check on the day · farmers market free to enter
mill_city_market.hours: Museum usually Tue–Sun · Saturday farmers market in season · check on the day
mill_city_market.tip: The rooftop view of the river and Stone Arch Bridge is the highlight. Saturday morning pairs the market with the museum.

guthrie_viewpoint.name: Guthrie Theater observation deck
guthrie_viewpoint.price_text: Free to enter the public areas
guthrie_viewpoint.hours: Building hours vary by show schedule · check on the day
guthrie_viewpoint.tip: The amber 'Endless Bridge' balcony gives a free framed view of the river and Stone Arch Bridge.

minnehaha_park.name: Minnehaha Regional Park and Falls
minnehaha_park.price_text: Free · parking may have a fee
minnehaha_park.hours: Park open daily · check on the day
minnehaha_park.tip: A short walk from the parking area reaches the falls. Best after rain or in spring melt.

north_loop_walk.name: North Loop neighbourhood walk
north_loop_walk.hours: Always open; shops and cafes have their own hours
north_loop_walk.tip: Brick warehouses, coffee shops and boutiques. Wander without a plan and stop for lunch.

chain_of_lakes.name: Chain of Lakes parkway walk
chain_of_lakes.tip: Walk or rent a bike around Lake Calhoun (Bde Maka Ska) and Lake Harriet. Busy but easy and flat.

mall_of_america.name: Mall of America
mall_of_america.price_text: Free to enter · attractions cost extra
mall_of_america.hours: Mall hours vary; usually open daily · check on the day
mall_of_america.tip: Huge indoor mall with an aquarium and theme park inside. Good rainy-day backup.

walker_art.name: Walker Art Center
walker_art.price_text: Admission varies; free days offered — check on the day
walker_art.hours: Usually closed Monday · check on the day
walker_art.tip: Modern art next door to the Sculpture Garden. Check for free-entry days before you buy.

stays.why: Walk to the riverfront, theaters and stadiums; easy light-rail links to the airport and Mall of America.
Lakes, cafés and local shops; a relaxed base south of downtown.
Breweries, art spaces and river paths in old industrial buildings.
Campus energy, cheap eats and the Green Line to both downtowns.

food: Try a Juicy Lucy: a burger with cheese melted inside the patty. Several local bars claim to have invented it.
Look for Nordic and Scandinavian-influenced cooking; the Twin Cities have a strong Nordic food scene.
Grab walleye (a local fish) or a wild rice dish for a taste of Minnesota.
Brewery taprooms are everywhere; many allow outside food or host food trucks.
Check hours before you go: some kitchens close early on weeknights, and many places are closed on Mondays.
more_time: Add a day in St. Paul: the Green Line light rail links both downtowns, with museums and old mansions to see.
Take the Blue Line to Mall of America for shopping and indoor rides on a rainy or cold day.
Head to Minnehaha Park and the river for a half-day of walking and a waterfall.
